title: Contact us
intro: Whether you're a student, a company, or just curious about what we do, feel free to get in touch! We usually reply quickly by email, but the organization is run by volunteer students, so it may take a little longer during exam season.
discordText: For students, Discord is the easiest way to reach us. There you'll find the whole Beta team, from the board to the committees and all the students. The board is usually active there, so feel free to ping us if you need anything.
